# Espey Mfg. & Electronics Corp. Receives $2.7 Million Sustainment Order for the M777 Howitzer Artillery Platform


by[Asher Nelligan](https://www.espey.com/author/easher/)


| Nov 19, 2026


|[Investor News](https://www.espey.com/category/investor-news/) ,[News](https://www.espey.com/category/news/) ,[Press Release](https://www.espey.com/category/press-release/)


*Saratoga Springs, NY, November 19, 2026* – Espey Mfg. & Electronics Corp. (NYSE American: ESP) announces award for their largest sustainment contract to date.


The Company has been awarded an additional sustainment contract in support of the M777 lightweight howitzer artillery platform. The $2.7 million award represents the Company’s largest sustainment contract to date. Under the agreement, the Company will supply specialized electronic power and communications components vital to the platform’s ongoing operations.


As a long-standing supplier to the M777 program, Espey provides high-reliability power and communications solutions engineered to perform in demanding field environments. This follow-on award demonstrates the Company’s continued commitment to the program and its role in sustaining critical defense systems.


Mr. David O’Neil, President and CEO, commented,


*We are proud to expand our support for the M777 program and our team remains focused on delivering the products necessary to contribute to the platform’s ongoing success. Securing this sustainment award highlights our customer’s confidence in our manufacturing performance, demonstrates the durability of our solutions, and strengthens our backlog with recurring program support. We value the relationship we have with our customer and look forward to continued collaboration.*


Espey’s primary business is the development, design, and production of specialized military and industrial power supplies/transformers. The Company can be found on the internet at[www.espey.com.](https://www.espey.com/)


*For further information, contact Ms. Kaitlyn O’Neil at[\[email protected\]](https://www.espey.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection) .*
